packageRules.description: Keep tomli below 2.4. winnow casts WINNOW_* values with tomli's TOML 1.0 grammar; tomli 2.4 and later read TOML 1.1 and cast values such as 12:30 differently. The shared preset's rangeStrategy 'replace' would otherwise lift the <2.4 cap in pyproject.toml. Lifting it is a decision for a person, made together with tests/config/env_corpus.json.

customManagers.description: Track the py-lintro image the lgtm-ci reusables run (#353). lgtm-ci's resolve-lintro-image.sh accepts only a digest-only reference, so the tag is the trailing comment on each lintro-image input line. The match starts at a line break and stays within the line; Renovate replaces the digest and the commented tag inside it. The shared preset groups this image with the lintro package.
